svg.title: Cheat sheet: what each job type adds to the event DAG
svg.desc: For each SchedulerJob type, the ScheduleEvents its Plan<Type>Job method creates, in order. Dashed events are conditional.
svg.metadata: ["Single-entity jobs: one event for the AGV, tray or bay the job names (a TrayMove for a carried tray; a stop-charging VecsTransition first for a tray on a charging VECS). They are the building blocks: other job methods create their TrayMoves through PlanReparkTrayJob and reuse PlanAgvMoveJob and PlanBayTransitionJob.", "Customer jobs through a bay. RETRIEVE switches the chosen bay to retrieve mode if needed, moves a tray already in the bay out (destination '?'), brings the car's tray in and hands over with PROCESS_RETRIEVE. INSERT opens the bay towards the garage, moves the loaded tray out to a spot chosen later, and after planning asks for a follow-up READY_FOR_INSERT job.", "Bay preparation. READY_FOR_INSERT sends a car that asked for charging to a VECS, brings an empty tray (chosen later, '?') into the bay and then switches it to insert mode. READY_FOR_RETRIEVE switches an insert-mode bay to retrieve mode and moves the tray in it out, to a VECS if its car asked for charging.", "Charging. CHARGE_PAYLOAD moves the tray onto a VECS found by ResolveBlockingTrays (unless it already sits on a ready one) and starts charging. CHARGE_AGV drives the AGV to the fastest free charger; only an AGV trapped in an insert-mode bay needs the bay switched to retrieve mode first and back to insert mode afterwards.", "Housekeeping jobs only compose other pieces. CLEAN_GARAGE hides the AGVs (only as job index 0) and plans trays left on waypoints back into parking. REBALANCE_GARAGE asks ComputeBayRebalancingActions() which bays to switch and runs the READY_FOR_INSERT / READY_FOR_RETRIEVE recipes for them; failures are only logged, so it never fails.", "The whole cheat sheet: every row is independent, read left to right in creation order. Dashed boxes appear only when needed, '+ recipe' calls another job method, and '?' is a blank for DoTrayAssignments()."]
